2607.16845.title: From Overload to Insights: How AI Agents Can Support Scientists in Analyzing Complex Data
2607.16845.paper_summary: Scientists at European XFEL conduct experiments that generate very large and complex datasets. The subsequent data analysis is challenging as scientists must combine their domain expertise with facility- and software-specific knowledge scattered across documentation, tools, and support channels. To address this problem, we designed and evaluated an agentic AI system tailored to the scientists' needs and integrated with the high-performance computing environment of European XFEL. Using a design science research approach, we conducted a rapid literature review, a systematic evaluation of 16 AI tools, multiple interviews, a focus group, and a user study with experts at European XFEL to develop and evaluate two prototypes. Our study identifies key knowledge challenges in scientific data analysis, derives requirements for an AI agent that supports knowledge retrieval and source code generation, and proposes design recommendations for a specialized system adaptable to the evolving AI tool landscape. These findings provide guidance for developing maintainable AI support in highly specialized scientific environments.
2607.16845.paper_summary_zh: 科學家在歐洲XFEL進行的實驗產生了非常大且複雜的數據集。隨後的數據分析具有挑戰性，因為科學家必須將他們的領域專業知識與分散在文檔、工具和支持渠道中的設施和軟件特定知識相結合。為了解決這個問題，我們設計並評估了一個針對科學家需求量身定制的代理AI系統，並與歐洲XFEL的高性能計算環境集成。使用設計科學研究方法，我們進行了快速文獻回顧、對16個AI工具的系統評估、多次訪談、一個焦點小組以及與歐洲XFEL專家的用戶研究，以開發和評估兩個原型。我們的研究確定了科學數據分析中的關鍵知識挑戰，推導出支持知識檢索和源代碼生成的AI代理的需求，並提出了針對可適應不斷發展的AI工具環境的專門系統的設計建議。這些發現為在高度專業化的科學環境中開發可維護的AI支持提供了指導。
